notes.title: Check Out The Cooking Club's New Redesign!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Chefs![/b][/h1][p]We've been busy cooking up a storm over here for The Cooking Club and preparing a wave wave of awesome stuff to show you all.. and we can finally begin doing that! Last night on the 18th of September 2025, we hosted [b]New Game+ 2025[/b] which is our[b] in house[/b] game studio showcase! We had guests like Blue Tango Street.. Studio Maroo.. and even twitch streamer and affiliate Clunia join us![/p][p][/p][p]So here we are.. and we don't want to waste anymore time.. so without further ado.. check out the trailer below alongside some new cover art (which you saw on this blog post) AND an updated "look" at the girls' via their "info cards" which can be found on our [b]Steam Page[/b].
Happy Cooking!

- Studio Z[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1AUaC2nPwhk;full"][/previewyoutube]
